description: Get composite scores (Security, SEO, Performance, Accessibility, AI-search readiness, AI visibility) for a target. Each score is 0-100 with a status rating, weighted over the tests that have measured; AI_VISIBILITY instead scores how answer engines treat the tracked prompts (an answer that names or cites the site 60, names and cites it 100), averaged per engine and then over engines, and its coverage counts engines (slugs ai-visibility:<ENGINE>). Next to it is its evidence coverage (TESTE-NO-449): coverageGrade GRADED / PROVISIONAL / INSUFFICIENT, coverage (% of the category's test weight with a fresh measured run), coverageSummary (one line) and missingTests (each test without fresh evidence and why: DISABLED, NEEDS_SETUP, PREREQUISITE, STALE, NOT_SCHEDULED, NOT_RUN_YET; for AI visibility engines also NOT_CONFIGURED, CAP_REACHED, FAILING). Present a PROVISIONAL score as provisional; never present an INSUFFICIENT score as a number (displayScore is null) — say what is missing instead.
name: get_target_scores
title: Get Target Composite Scores
